title: informational-spacetime
description: The aperiodic base field: codomain of cosmogenerating and top of the four-field descent (informational → quantum → classical → thermal). The bit-field — 'it from bit' as a spacetime regime (κ ≥ ω₁, H¹ ≠ 0). Its library is the descent: marking/realizing/forgetting/condensing, with condensing → quantum-spacetime → collapsing → classical-spacetime → thermalizing → thermal-spacetime. The observable cosmos (structure, expansion, constituents, cosmology) is classical-spacetime content. 'Cosmos' is reserved for a downstream restriction (our tile).
